better_inventory.setting.sort_buttons.to: Shows a small sort button by your inventory and by chests, barrels and shulker boxes. The sort key works either way.
better_inventory.setting.sort_order.tool: How sorted stacks line up. Groups follows the creative inventory's order.
better_inventory.sort_order.name: Name
better_inventory.setting.refill.tooltip: When the stack in your hand runs out or your tool breaks, the next matching one from your inventory moves into its place.
Auto-refill also tops up your off hand: torches, totems, food.
better_inventory.setting.refill_similar_: When a tool breaks and there is no other one of it, any tool of the same kind takes its place (any pickaxe for a pickaxe).
better_inventory.setting.hud.tooltip: Shows your armor and what you hold beside the hotbar, with how much each has left.
better_inventory.setting.hud_main_hand.t: The item in your main hand.
better_inventory.setting.hud_off_hand.to: The item in your off hand.
better_inventory.setting.hud_plain_items: Also shows held items that never wear out, such as blocks and food, as an icon alone.
better_inventory.setting.hud_style.toolt: Percent, a small bar, the uses left, or the icon alone.
better_inventory.setting.hud_color.toolt: Green when fresh, yellow halfway, red when nearly worn out. Off: white.
better_inventory.setting.hud_sides.toolt: Both: main hand, helmet and chestplate on the left, off hand, leggings and boots on the right. Or everything on one side.
The hotbar's selection frame slides to the new slot instead of jumping. The slot itself changes at once.
better_inventory.setting.selector_glide_: 1 is a slow glide, 10 is nearly instant.
better_inventory.setting.selector_spring: The gliding frame overshoots a little and settles back.
better_inventory.setting.selector_wrap.t: Going from the last slot to the first (or back), the frame leaves by one end and comes in at the other instead of crossing the whole hotbar.
better_inventory.setting.selected_lift.t: The selected slot's item is drawn a little larger than the rest.
better_inventory.setting.item_wobble.too: Items grow and shrink with a little bounce instead of smoothly.
better_inventory.setting.use_pulse.toolt: A hotbar item gives a small squeeze when it is used: a block placed, food eaten, a tool worn.
better_inventory.setting.pickups.tooltip: Lists the items, experience and arrows you pick up in a corner of the screen for a few seconds. More of something still listed adds to its line.
better_inventory.setting.pickup_corner.t: Which corner of the screen the list sits in. It keeps above the hotbar, the equipment HUD and the chat, and below the effect icons.
better_inventory.setting.pickup_xp.toolt: Experience orbs you collect get a line too, with the points they gave.
better_inventory.setting.pickup_names.to: Each line shows the item's name beside its icon. Off: only the icon and the amount.
better_inventory.setting.pickup_time.too: Seconds a line stays before it fades away. Picking up more of it starts the time again.
better_inventory.setting.pickup_rows.too: The most lines shown at once; the newest are kept.
better_inventory.setting.accent.tooltip: The colour of Better Inventory's cards and highlights. Sunrise orange (#F9801D) by default.
